notes.title: The Steam Next Fest is a go!
notes.notes: [p]We are delighted to announce that the demo version of [i]32, Dandelion Drift[/i] takes part in the Steam Next Fest 2025! We hope that you'll visit Dan and Claire at the start of their adventure! [/p][p][/p][p]See you in an hour, at 19:00 CEST[/p][p][/p][p]-Piotr[/p]

notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525265/76c17efc46b7dc5a0d7669a20c8a579be358d954.png[/img]

[b]Demo is available now for download! [/b]

Take a sneak peek at the story and get to know our main characters! In this preview, we give you a little bit of everything: joy, humor, but also uneasiness and mortal peril. Be careful not to slip on the first hurdle.

See you at 32, Dandelion Drift!

-Piotr
